Company: Rieke do Brasil Embalagens Ltda.

Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled

Main Duties & Responsibilities

Position Summary: Perform setup, optimization, and troubleshooting of injection molding processes to ensure the stable and efficient production of high-quality plastic components for dispensing, closure, and flexible packaging solutions, preferred experience in companies as Olan de Mexico, Silgan dispensing systems.

Create the process for new molds and FAT.

Support daily production, perform injection process, and maintain process documentation (standard operation procedures, Process data sheet, process parameters data sheet).

Train the process technician to guarantee that they are following the standard parameters.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Document the set up, adjust, and optimize injection molding machines and auxiliary equipment for daily production.
  • Troubleshoot molding issues (e.g., short shots, flash, sink marks) and adjust process parameters as needed to maintain product quality and documentation.
  • Monitor/Audit process parameters and machine performance to ensure stable operation.

  • Collaborate with Maintenance, Tooling, and Quality teams to resolve process and equipment issues.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and safety protocols.
  • Maintain process documentation, including process sheets, parameter settings, and troubleshooting logs.
  • Support continuous improvement activities related to cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process stability.
  • Train and mentor other technicians and machine operators on best practices.
  • Homologate new molds and create the properly parameters.
  • Responsible for FAT for new molds.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Technical diploma or vocational certification in Plastics, Mechanical, or Industrial Technology preferred.
  • 10+ years of hands‑on experience operating and troubleshooting injection molding machines, mandatory in the packaging (Dispensing) companies.
  • Working knowledge of injection molding machines (e.g., Haitian, Milacron, Husky, Wittman) and auxiliary equipment (e.g., dryers, mold temperature controllers).
  • Ability to interpret part drawings and basic mold designs.
  • Problem‑solving skills with a focus on root cause identification and corrective actions.
  • Understanding of polymer materials used in packaging (PP, PE, ABS, etc.).
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to product quality and safety.
  • Willingness to work in shifts and respond to production needs.

description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let’s start with the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Principal Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our MS SQL Server environments, with a strong focus on availability, security, and performance. You will play a key role in ensuring the continuous operation of our databases, particularly in complex, high-availability scenarios such as Availability Groups. In addition, you will bring your knowledge of alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB, as well as your expertise in cloud-based database administration.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive day-to-day support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration for multiple MS SQL databases, with a particular focus on high-availability configurations like Availability Groups.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and availability issues, with in-depth root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Oversee database maintenance processes, including performance tuning , index management, and job automation, ensuring optimal operation.
  • Develop and enforce policies for backup and recovery , ensuring database resilience and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.
  • Handle support calls and resolve technical issues swiftly, including response to security incidents and operational challenges.
  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
  • A commitment to mentoring and supporting junior team members.

Main responsibilities

Técnico de Ferramentas e Dispositivos

  • Executar o Setup de máquinas CNC e afins, conforme a programação diária;
  • Realizar a montagem de dispositivos para fixação de peças, conforme plano de montagem virtual ou impresso fornecido pela programação CNC;
  • Organizar os componentes e ferramentas no setor de Preparação de Máquinas, bem como manter a integridade e a aferição de seus instrumentos;

Planejador de Usinagem

  • Planejar, controlar e programar a fabricação de peças na Usinagem, elaborando e disponibilizando roteiros na fábrica;

  • Participar de reuniões diárias de acompanhamento da produção, bem como fazer a tratativa para resolução de problemas, orientações, correções de desvios e atualizações no planejamento, sempre que necessário.

Programador CNC

  • Atuar na elaboração de processos de Usinagem e Programação CNC em software CAM NX para fresamento e torneamento;
  • Criação de dispositivos de fixação/componentes e desenvolvimento de ferramentas de usinagem para manufatura do produto GROB;
  • Análise, correção e melhoria de desenhos junto ao Projeto;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Usinagem, Projeto, Montagem, Planejamento e Controle de Qualidade;
  • Modificar e elaborar roteiros de Usinagem;
  • Suporte técnico as máquinas;
  • Preparação de Máquinas e Ferramentas e acompanhamento de testes em geral e programas de usinagem nas máquinas (Try-Out).

Requirements and skills

Se você tem interesse em atuar como Técnico de Ferramentas e Dispositivos, é necessário: Técnico completo em Mecânica ou similar; Conhecer os processos de Usinagem; Conhecer aplicações técnicas de ferramentas e estratégias de soluções de Usinagem; Saber efetuar cálculos de dados de corte e vida útil das ferramentas; Saber identificar problemas de Usinagem e sugerir soluções; Ter habilidade com o Pacote Office e se você tiver experiência em SAP será um diferencial.

Se você tem interesse em atuar como Planejador de Usinagem, é necessário: Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia Mecânica, Produção ou similar; Conhecer os processos de fabricação da Usinagem e métodos de planejamento da produção; Saber ler e interpretar desenho técnico; Ter habilidade com o Pacote Office e conhecimento em SAP. Inglês Avançado será um diferencial.

Se você tem interesse em atuar como Programador CNC, é necessário: Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção ou similar; Conhecer os processos e métodos de Usinagem CNC, Máquinas CNC, Ferramentas de Usinagem, Programação e Sistemas de Fixação para Usinagem; Saber ler e interpretar desenho técnico; Experiência com os comandos Siemens e Heidenhain em máquinas 4 e 5 eixos e tornos multitarefa; Dominar o software de Usinagem CAM NX; Inglês Avançado.

Sobre a Dynamox

Somos uma indústria especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a manutenção preditiva em ativos industriais. O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva que ontem.

Ao produzirmos os hardwares e softwares da nossa solução, buscamos apresentar aos nossos clientes e parceiros o porquê de sermos referência em soluções eficientes e eficazes para monitoramento, manutenção e performance de ativos.

Além disso, temos orgulho em possuir as certificações das ISOs 9001, 27001, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, buscamos promover a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente, através de uma cultura interna onde os funcionários são incentivados a buscar a excelência em suas atividades, com oportunidades regulares de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional.

Conheça mais sobre nós, visite nosso site.

Sobre a equipe na qual você irá atuar

O Time Inspeção desenvolve soluções de software voltadas para a digitalização das rotinas de inspeção para o sistema APM da Dynamox, que permite monitorar as condições de ativos industriais, otimizar o planejamento e os fluxos de trabalho de inspeção.

Este time é composto de desenvolvedores de software (full-stack e mobile), todos responsáveis pela experiência dos clientes.

As demandas do time envolvem implementação de novas funcionalidades, manutenção de produto, manutenção de ferramentas e infra.

Atividades do cargo

  • Projetar, desenvolver, testar, implantar, monitorar, manter, renovar e descomissionar de forma autônoma e exemplar, software com ciclo de vida longo integrado a outros sistemas, no lado do cliente (front-end) e no lado do servidor (back-end);
  • Desenvolver, de forma autônoma e exemplar, software que esteja de acordo com as diretrizes, políticas e estratégias da empresa, garantindo a consistência e alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Interpretar protótipos gráficos e wireframes, colaborar ativamente e liderar a definição de requisitos testáveis de interfaces visuais e regras de negócio, assim como oferecer estimativas de complexidade para implementação;
  • Manter comunicação e feedback regular com líderes e pares através dos canais de comunicação definidos, informando status das atividades, pontos de bloqueio e resultados obtidos, liderando o planejamento de ações futuras;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento, através de condução de práticas de pair programming, publicação de artigos, mentorias, documentação de decisões técnicas, funcionalidades, processos, incidentes e aprendizados;
  • Participar e conduzir ações de resolução de incidentes de forma autônoma e mentorando outros membros no processo;
  • Contribuir e disseminar práticas de segurança de informação e privacidade de dados confidenciais e restritos, no que diz respeito às rotinas do departamento e empresa;

Requisitos

  • Linguagens de programação: TypeScript e JavaScript;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de front-end (ex. react, vite) e back-end (Node.js);
  • Experiência em nuvem (ex: GCP, AWS, Azure) utilizando tecnologias de conteinerização e provisionamento (ex: Docker, Kubernetes, etc);
  • Experiência com dados SQL e NOSQL (ex.: Postgres, Mongo DB);

Unidades Básicas de Saúde (UBS) são serviços que compõem a Rede de Atenção Básica de Saúde, caracterizados pelo alto nível de capilaridade e pela oferta de serviços de saúde com maior proximidade dos usuários. Suas atividades estão voltadas para apromoção ,proteção erecuperação da saúde eprevenção de doenças, de forma individual ou coletiva, articulada com outros serviços da Rede de Saúde e intersetorial.

As UBS oferecem, mediante agendamento, atendimento médico nas especialidades de Pediatria, Ginecologia e Clínica-Médica e atendimento de Equipe Multiprofissional com Enfermagem, Odontologia, Serviço Social, Nutrição e Psicologia em algumas Unidades. Também são oferecidos procedimentos (inalações, injeções, curativos, vacinas, coleta de exames laboratoriais, tratamento odontológico, coleta de Papanicolau), além de encaminhamento para serviços de Especialidades e fornecimento de medicação básica.

Desenvolver a sistematização da assistência de enfermagem à populações sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual e coletiva, incluindo ações no domicilio, conforme epidemiologia local. Realizar a organização das atividades das equipes de trabalho, bem como dos processos de enfermagem sob sua responsabilidade. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Pós-graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Saúde Pública, Saúde Coletiva, Estratégia Saúde da Família ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Enfermeiro na Atenção Básica.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador) deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Step 3: AVALIAÇÃO 3 AVALIAÇÃO

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Credit Risk Associate - Asset Based Lending Group
description:
Job Description

As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class.

As a Credit Risk Associate in the Asset Based Lending Group of the Commercial and Investment Bank, your responsibility will be to: i.) support in the management of a portfolio of Global Corporate Banking ("GCB") and Investment Bank ("IB") clients that have Asset Based loans and ii.) support in the independent analysis and review of credit exposure for new and existing ABL clients, in a second chair capacity until such time that the Associate demonstrates ability to work as the primary ABL credit contact. ABL Credit Risk professionals lead the ABL client credit relationship along with GCB and IB Bankers who manage the overall relationship, as well as partnering closely with the IB credit team and ABL Originations/Syndications. The role involves extensive interaction with clients, product and functional partners, internal and external legal counsel, lenders, and investors.

Job Responsibilities

  • Participate in all aspects of the credit relationship, including credit analysis, financial modeling and coordinating credit approval for all products including loans, derivatives, leases, and cash management.
  • Proactively support and enhance client relationships.
  • Recommend changes in structure and account management strategy to address negative trends. Assess monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and ongoing borrowing base reporting and collateral diligence and monitoring. Assigns and assesses internal ratings, risk assessment, and risk mitigation.
  • Participate in structuring and negotiating Credit Agreements, amendments, waivers and related legal documents.
  • Manage and monitor loan products including affirmative, negative, and financial covenant compliance. Manage on-going communication with bank group members.
  • Review, interpret, and implement findings from collateral appraisals and field exams. On-going monitoring of collateral trends and liquidity, establishing reserves, and recommending appropriate course of action to address issues.
  • Partner with Bankers, IB Credit, ABL Originations/Syndications, Debt Capital Markets, Syndicated Leveraged Finance, Treasury Services, Leasing, Derivatives, and Loan Operations.
  • Communicate with Senior Management, respond to regulatory requests, and maintain internal credit files.
  • Support the credit team in projection modeling, independent analysis, and review of new or modified ABL exposure for prospects and existing clients.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Minimum 3 plus years experience in Credit Risk with Asset Based Lending knowledge a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred
  • Formal credit training a plus

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world’s most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan’s Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianischen Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere freundlichen und sehr motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler kennen und lernen in zwei Kulturkreisen und das bereits vom Kindergarten an. Auf diese Weise bekommen sie erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes vermittelt.

Angeboten wird eine Stelle in Vollzeit. Das Deputat umfasst 26 Stunden pro Unterrichtswoche. Neben der unterrichtlichen Tätigkeit ist die Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Erforderlich sind hohe Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation sowie Teamfähigkeit und ein starkes Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika).   • Lehrbefähigung in Fach Musik + abiturrelevantes Fach (SEK II, DIA: Deutsch, Englisch, Mathematik, Philosophie, Biologie, Chemie, Physik, Kunst)

  • Überdurchschnittliche Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier und Arbeitsfreude,

description:
O Coordenador de Perdas é responsável por identificar, monitorar e implementar estratégias para prevenir perdas, fraudes e riscos operacionais. Atua diretamente na área de Security e Loss Prevention , garantindo a proteção dos ativos da empresa, a integridade das operações logísticas e a segurança de colaboradores e clientes. Este profissional desempenha um papel estratégico na identificação de vulnerabilidades, análise de dados e desenvolvimento de soluções para reduzir perdas financeiras e operacionais, alinhando-se aos valores e objetivos da DeLuna.

Requisitos Técnicos e Comportamentais

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Administração, Logística, Gestão de Segurança, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável especialização ou cursos na área de Loss Prevention , Gestão de Riscos ou Auditoria .

Experiência Profissional:

  • Experiência prévia em prevenção de perdas, segurança patrimonial ou gestão de riscos em empresas de logística, transporte ou varejo.
  • Conhecimento em operações logísticas (armazenagem, distribuição, transporte).

Competências Técnicas:

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e rastreamento (TMS, WMS, sistemas de CFTV).
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e auditoria.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel avançado é um diferencial).
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias de investigação e compliance.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Alta performance: Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e entregar resultados consistentes.
  • Autogerenciamento: Organização e proatividade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Adaptabilidade: Habilidade para lidar com mudanças e novos desafios.
  • Atitude de dono: Comprometimento com os objetivos da empresa e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Aprendizado contínuo: Interesse em se atualizar sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de prevenção de perdas.

Principais Responsabilidades

Monitoramento e Prevenção de Perdas:

  • Identificar e analisar causas de perdas financeiras, operacionais e de ativos.
  • Implementar políticas e procedimentos para prevenir furtos, extravios, danos e fraudes.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas internas de segurança e prevenção de perdas em todas as operações logísticas (First Mile, Middle Mile, Last Mile, etc.).

Análise de Dados e Relatórios:

  • Realizar auditorias e investigações internas para identificar irregularidades e propor melhorias.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance relacionados a perdas e segurança (KPIs).
  • Elaborar relatórios analíticos e apresentar insights para a liderança, sugerindo ações corretivas e preventivas.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Mapear vulnerabilidades nos processos logísticos e propor soluções para mitigação de riscos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de contingência e protocolos de segurança.
  • Atuar em parceria com equipes de tecnologia para melhorar sistemas de rastreamento e monitoramento em tempo real.

Treinamento e Conscientização:

  • Capacitar equipes operacionais e administrativas sobre boas práticas de segurança e prevenção de perdas.
  • Promover a cultura de segurança e integridade entre colaboradores e parceiros da DeLuna.

Parcerias e Alinhamento Estratégico:

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com fornecedores, transportadores e clientes para garantir a segurança da cadeia logística.
  • Colaborar com a área de compliance para assegurar que as práticas de prevenção estejam alinhadas às normas regulatórias e aos valores da empresa.

Requisitos:

title: WTM Latin America reforça protagonismo dos agentes de viagens
description:
Overview

O Agente na Estrada chega à edição 2026 da WTM Latin America consolidado como um dos programas mais relevantes de capacitação e relacionamento do encontro, promovendo a participação de agentes de viagens de diferentes regiões do Brasil no principal evento B2B de turismo da América Latina. A iniciativa mantém o foco na ampliação do acesso ao conteúdo, ao networking qualificado e às oportunidades de negócios geradas pela feira, que será realizada entre 14 e 16 de abril, no Expo Center Norte, em São Paulo.

O programa preserva sua estrutura, critérios de participação e princípios, e aprofunda o olhar estratégico sobre a experiência do agente dentro da WTM Latin America. Propõe proporcionar uma imersão completa no evento, conectando agentes de viagens a operadoras, destinos, redes hoteleiras, empresas de mobilidade e fornecedores de serviços e tecnologia, em um ambiente pensado para estimular trocas qualificadas.

Bianca Pizzolito, Event Leader da WTM Latin America, reforça que o Agente na Estrada é um programa proprietário, consolidado e concebido para facilitar o aproveitamento estratégico da feira, oferecendo acesso estruturado ao conteúdo, aos expositores e às conexões que efetivamente impactam o negócio no dia a dia.

Critérios de participação 2026

  • Priorizar agentes de viagens com CNPJ ativo há mais de cinco anos.
  • Registro regular no Cadastur.
  • Relacionamento comprovado com operadoras e fornecedores do mercado.
  • Acompanhar a programação oficial do evento.
  • Realizar o agendamento de reuniões com expositores por meio da plataforma da WTM.

Benefícios

  • Apoio logístico e acesso facilitado ao evento.
  • Participação em encontros e ações exclusivas.
  • Possibilidade de ampliar o portfólio de produtos, conhecer lançamentos e estreitar relações comerciais com players estratégicos do setor.
  • Contato direto com tendências, novos modelos de negócio e oportunidades ao longo da feira para fortalecimento da atuação no mercado.

Inscrições e participação

As inscrições para o Agente na Estrada 2026 estarão disponíveis em breve no site oficial da WTM Latin America. A organização limita as vagas a 500 participantes. O engajamento deve ser o mesmo registrado nas edições anteriores, quando reuniu agentes de diferentes estados e regiões do país.

A WTM Latin America ocorrerá entre 14 e 16 de abril de 2026, no Expo Center Norte, em São Paulo.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

bAbout AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

What you’ll do:

Management routine

  • Manage and lead a high-performance team of Data Analysts and Analytics Engineers (8 to 10 resources).
  • Work with product leaders, engineering, and commercial strategy to form a unified data-driven strategy.
  • Support analysis request prioritization with stakeholders and Data Product Managers (DPMs).
  • Actively balance team leadership efforts with practical development/coding of data products, metrics, and visualizations to drive business.

Technical routine

  • Review to verify that best practices have been followed for high-quality products, recommend appropriate data sources and models, ensuring scalability and high reuse.
  • Drive the business strategy by providing insights into current performance and highlighting areas of opportunity for growth. To do this, conduct advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning models to answer specific business questions, extract insights and predictive patterns from large datasets to explain and expose potential opportunities from the data.
  • Develop data sets/schemas consuming data from multiple sources such as internal databases, analysis tools, unstructured sources, and other external sources.
  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of complex data models, data structures, and best practices for data governance to support the data platform team in definitions and executions following best practices appropriate to use cases.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed in Information Systems, Data Science and Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Engineering, or other data-related fields, with a strong foundation in Statistics.

  • Advanced English is mandatory - will work with a global team.
  • Experience with B2B portfolio management would be a big plus .
  • Expertise in database query and reporting tools (SQL + Power BI + DAX).
  • Effective skills in programming languages (Python, PySpark, SQL).
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, using Git for code versioning, and actively participating in code review practices.
  • Strong experience with relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database technologies.
  • Prior experience in cloud data solutions (e.g., Databricks , Redshift, BigQuery, Teradata, Snowflake) and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.
  • Experience in analyzing data to identify key insights, gaps, and inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with the Systems Development Life Cycle and Agile Methodology.

Soft Skills:

  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and analytical insights to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Promote collaboration and a productive work environment by sharing knowledge and experience with direct subordinates.
  • Proven ability to seek unconventional solutions, explore opportunities, and develop innovative solutions.

title: Stadium Guest Operations Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Guest Operations Stadium Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of seamless V/VIP guest services and operations within the stadiums for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, internal FIFA27 teams, and external stakeholders. The role acts as the primary point of reference for all stadium guest operations, ensuring efficient planning, staff readiness, and high-quality service delivery during match operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of V/VIP services and guest operations across assigned stadiums.
  • Establish, manage, and coordinate stadium-level Guest Operations teams, ensuring clear task allocation in line with the event scope.
  • Support the Guest Operations Senior Manager in the development and implementation of Concepts of Operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Communicate guest management policies, stadium operational plans, and updates to all relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure management of V/VIP Guests (local & international) is according to agreed operational plans.
  • Ensure agreed service levels are consistently delivered in collaboration with internal departments, service providers, and partners.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Guest Experience Manager on the planning and delivery of V/VIP catering services and lounge experience within the stadium environment.
  • Develop, monitor, and manage key milestones, activity schedules, and workflows, ensuring clear prioritisation and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to budget planning and support the monitoring and review of stadium guest operations expenditures.
  • Plan and deliver stadium-specific V/VIP operations training for Guest Operations Stadium staff, volunteers, hosts, and hostesses.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Tourism, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is considered an asset.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Guest Operations, Event Services, Protocol, or Hospitality operations within major events, preferably international sports events.
  • Proven experience in stadium or venue-based operations, including V/VIP services and multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, coordination, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working with multiple service providers and cross-functional teams in complex operational settings.
  • Experience in budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial tracking is desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence and deliver high-quality guest services through structured processes and teamwork.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels.
  • High level of attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and sound judgement under pressure.
  • Good understanding of organisational processes, governance, and operational policies.
  • Solid financial awareness, including budget management and cost control.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and event days, as required by the tournament schedule.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and international environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

We are seeking to expand MSCI’s Index Client Coverage Team in Latin America with a commercially driven and results-oriented individual with financial services sales experience. The Index Sales Specialist will play a critical role in driving MSCI’s index business across key markets in Latin America. The individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with institutional investors, asset managers, banks, and other financial institutions. This role combines sales, business development, product expertise, and client engagement to grow MSCI’s footprint in this strategic region. Success requires a consummate relationship builder, both internally and externally, to drive sales and achieve revenue targets. The individual will work closely with all parts of MSCI, including Client Service, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Research, and Product Management.

Travel across the region is required to meet clients, attend conferences, and strengthen relationships.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a sales strategy to grow MSCI’s Index franchise across Latin America.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities with asset managers, wealth managers, banks, broker-dealers, pension funds, insurance companies, and other financial institutions.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key decision-makers and influencers within client organizations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Research, Product Management, Client Service, Legal) to deliver tailored index solutions.
  • Manage the full sales cycle and ensure contract renewals and run‑rate retention.
  • Represent MSCI at client meetings, conferences, and industry events.
  • Provide client feedback to help shape product development and strategic initiatives.

  • +8 years of experience overall, and +4 years of experience specifically in Sales in financial services, preferably in client coverage within Index, ETF, or Data sales.
  • Strong passion for business development, client prospecting, and account management.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment; strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to understand technical products and market trends.
  • Good understanding of capital markets and investment processes.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration. Master’s Degree, MBA, or CFA designation is a plus.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively across Latin America.

What we offer you

  • Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.

  • A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.

All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. title: Sr. Partner Growth Manager, Amazon Fuse
description:
Are you data driven and like identifying actionable insights that translate into growth initiatives that drive the business? Excel in identifying and communicating mutually beneficial customer and partner propositions and benefits? A creative marketer that can think big and make it happen? Then the Partner Growth Marketing team at Amazon could be the perfect fit for you, where we build dynamic future for Amazon subscriptions across the globe.

The Partner Growth Marketing team (Fuse) within Amazon’s Corporate Business Development group enables partners across multiple verticals to resell our subscription services including Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited, Kindle Unlimited, and more. You will work with Amazon partners across Brasil and have a direct impact on end customers, seeking to maximize acquisition and customer retention with these partners across existing and new customer segments and offers. Our partners leverage Amazon’s services to drive differentiated offerings and streamlined access for their customers across the globe. We need experienced growth marketing leaders to help us drive great results and grow our established subscription member bases, while help us launch new ones. The team is seeking a talented, self‑directed and high energy growth marketing innovator to help drive our efforts in Brasil, including successful partner launches and strong customer adoption, engagement, and retention. Our ideal candidate will have demonstrated an ability to build successful launch and growth campaigns, by diving deep into the insights around customer data including video streaming and online shopping usage trends, analyzing and reducing churn, while managing the customer lifecycle all the way through the funnel. The candidate must be able to work collaboratively and independently, building trust across internal teams as well as external partners. The focus will be on building, measuring and optimizing successful, results‑oriented marketing programs in a fast‑paced environment, often with speedy timelines, across new partner launches and on‑going campaigns focused on growth marketing efforts that acquire new customers to our subscription services. This person must also have experience in creating centralized programs that can be leveraged on a global scale, both directly and by others. Above all, this person must have a passion for understanding what drives a great consumer experience (CX) across both the digital and physical space. The candidate should possess a builder/start‑up mentality and work well in ambiguous situations.

Key job responsibilities

  • Deliver against an annual forecast of Prime and Prime Video subscriptions driven by partners.
  • Collaborating internally and working across cross‑functional teams to deliver best in class campaign opportunities and assets for our partners across Prime, Prime Video, and more.
  • Working closely with partners to understand their customers, how their business operates, their goals and their approach to marketing and content, and owning the end‑to‑end delivery of all partner launches and subsequent growth marketing efforts to drive signups to our subscription services post‑launch.
  • Leading, implementing and launching partner campaign with the North Star to deliver best‑in‑class creative excellence that represents both Prime/Prime Video brand and Fuse offer awareness through a partner.
  • Diving deep into the data to understand insights and learnings, that in turn drive strategy. Lead performance for partners in your region. Share market intelligence and insights with stakeholders and other teammates.
  • Manage end‑to‑end ideation, execution, and analysis/reporting on campaigns including work‑back‑schedules, stakeholder approvals, asset/content set‑up, and subsequent launch.
  • Develop efficient, scalable mechanisms that ensure operational efficiency of the team and acquisition impact.
  • Creating ongoing marketing programs and propositions for key partners to market our services, and drive customer engagement and retention.
  • Continually optimizing partnerships from launch through to ongoing sustaining efforts to maximize offer discoverability, frequency in comms, and share of voice (SOV).
  • Diving deep on the customer journey to deliver a great experience and great results.
  • Leading, influencing, and executing integrated go‑to‑market plans with multiple partners in different business verticals and across relevant internal teams.
  • Building ongoing communication channels with and through partners.
  • Partnering with Business Development leads on the sell‑in of new partnerships with pitches, proposals, and B2B communications that bring Amazon’s services and content to life.
  • Experimenting with new ways to drive partnership success.
  • Functioning at a global level, sharing best practices, and scaling programs or campaigns that benefit North America, Latin America, and other regions.

Basic Qualifications

  • +8 years of marketing experience in B2B2C partner‑focused growth marketing across different industries such as: mobile, telecommunications, retail, financial institutions, film, media, music, television or gaming.
  • Ability to view partners as customers, focusing on their needs and goals, and driving great programs for customers that drive great results for partners.
  • Ability to create innovative new programs around entertainment and shopping seasonalities that generate results.
  • Relentless focus on data to make decisions and drive results, able to identify actionable learnings that explain/drive results.
  • Ability to analyze and dive deep on end‑to‑end CX flows to improve customer experience.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with senior management both internally and externally.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi‑partner relationships/projects.
  • Strong bias for action and ownership, and ability to work independently toward stated goals with minimal oversight.
  • A passion for managing details to optimize programs, tools, and creatives. Attention to details to continuously raise the bar.
  • Demonstrated track record in developing, implementing and optimizing multi‑channel, integrated marketing campaigns that focus on growth/performance marketing.
  • Excellent written communications and business case writing skills.
  • Must be willing to travel.
  • Ability to influence and earn trust.
  • High sense of ownership.
  • Business‑level fluency in English (written and verbal).

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA preferred
  • Relevant work experience in integrated partner marketing within the mobile/telecom or related industries, subscriptions, and/or entertainment, financial institutions and sponsorships.
  • Experience in global and/or centralized marketing leadership teams.
  • A passion for video content (film and television) a plus.

title: Operations Manager, Logistics
description:
Company Overview

Nestig is a direct-to-consumer brand with a mission to create the most delightful place to shop for children’s spaces. Our brand is synonymous with quality, care, and trust, offering customers a seamless shopping experience and exceptional products for their little ones. As one of the fastest-growing consumer brands since 2021, Operations is essential to our culture, and we believe this is a key part of what sets us apart from the competition. We strive to execute streamlined, backend logistics to ensure customers receive their items in a timely and secure way.

Department Overview

As part of Nestig’s Operations team, you will play a strategic, hands‑on leadership role overseeing the full Customs and Logistics function across Brazil, North America, Europe, and Asia. Reporting directly to the Head of Operations, you will manage a team of three and lead critical logistics operations, people development, and global partner relationships. You will navigate complex cross‑border challenges while driving continuous improvement and cost optimization across the supply chain. In close partnership with Scheduling, Customer Experience, and Product Development, you will ensure efficient end‑to‑end product movement: from manufacturing and export through warehousing, customs clearance, last‑mile delivery, and customer satisfaction.

This full-time position will be based out of our São Paulo office in Pinheiros.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of three direct reports across varying levels, fostering continuous growth and high-performance culture through clear expectation setting, structured feedback, effective delegation, and hands‑on support when needed;
  • Own end‑to‑end international import and export workflows, managing and negotiating with global carrier partners to resolve escalations and meet cost, performance, and service‑level benchmarks;
  • Manage operations across all U.S. partner warehouses, ensuring accurate inventory, SLA compliance, and continuous process improvement;
  • Develop, monitor, and refine KPIs for team performance, compliance, and operational excellence, using data‑driven insights to measure success and inform company‑wide improvements;
  • Design streamlined processes that reduce transit delays, losses, and damage across all operations, working closely with the Product Development team to enhance packaging quality while maintaining competitive shipping costs;
  • Oversee tracking processes, ensuring proactive communication and rapid issue resolution across customs and internal teams;
  • Manage and onboard white glove delivery partners, ensuring quality standards, customer satisfaction, and ongoing partner development;
  • Lead freight cost optimization initiatives, driving savings through commercial negotiations, operational redesign, and carrier performance reviews;
  • Own carrier invoice and import tax validation processes, ensuring accuracy and preventing financial leakage;
  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert for logistics and fulfillment operations, equipping the team with the knowledge and guidance needed to address inquiries across carriers, customs, and end‑to‑end supply chain workflows.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years experience in Logistics and Operations, with at least 2 years in a people‑management role.
  • Must be able to work onsite in our São Paulo office in Pinheiros (Fradique Coutinho subway station) three (3) days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday).
  • Experience in a early‑stage, growth‑oriented within fast‑paced company, or global operations is strongly preferred
  • Excellent communications skills in Portuguese and English (Level B2), both verbal and written, with a knack for creative problem‑solving, negotiation and calm, confident conflict resolution.
  • A passion for talent development and team management, giving structured feedback, delegating effectively and fostering a collaborative and motivational environment.
  • Fast learner with sharp problem‑solving and negotiation skills and excellent judgment.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and adapt quickly to changing business needs.
  • Hands‑on and proactive when needed, while still operating with a strategic, managerial approach.
  • Highly analytical, data‑driven mindset with the ability to transform data into strategies and operational improvements.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI is a plus.
  • A passion for building processes, improving operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Ability to embody and exercise Nestig's Core Values in all facets of the business.
  • Legal authorization to work in Brazil (We are available to hire as Freelancer ("PF") or Contractor ("PJ")).

Why You’ll Love Working Here!

  • Total Rewards: dive into our TOTAL REWARDS DECK to learn more about Nestig’s benefits and perks
  • Comprehensive medical benefits through Alice for you and your loved onesTwenty-one (21) business days* per calendar year, prorated from your start date, so you can take your well‑earned R&R (*What is a business day? A business day is a weekday that the business is open (non‑governmental holiday weekdays). This means that PTO requests will not need to include weekend day(s) and/or governmental holiday(s) that hug a particular day you are requesting off.)
  • Flexible Work From Wherever (WFW) Policy — up to five (5) weeks of remote work per year, prorated from your start date
  • Monthly wellness, IT, and commuter stipend
  • WFW stipend, so you are able to create a comfortable working environment at home
  • Annual education stipend, because we are always learning
  • Nestig discount, so you can treat you, your family & loved ones!
  • Paid parental leave of sixteen (16) weeks after six (6) months of employment for birthing and non‑birthing parents.

What will this interview process look like?

  • We believe that interviews should be a two‑way street — an opportunity for us to get to know you, and for you to learn about life at Nestig. To help you feel prepared and confident, we’ve outlined each step of this recruitment process HERE.

Nestig is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, national origin, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected class. We believe that diversity is more than just good intentions, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

description:
Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As a Technical Support Automation Specialist at TRACTIAN, you will serve as the bridge between technical support and automation engineering, providing high-level technical assistance to our clients and ensuring robust integration of our monitoring solutions in industrial environments. You will be responsible for validating, implementing, and maintaining industrial communication systems, integrating PLCs and sensors, interpreting electrical diagrams, and ensuring system performance. You will also act as a technical reference during the implementation and post-implementation phases, supporting both on-site and remote operations.

  • Provide technical support for automation-related issues, ensuring the correct operation and integration of sensors, PLCs, and monitoring platforms.

  • Interpret and adjust electrical diagrams and PLC logic during installations or support requests.
  • Collaborate with Hardware, Data Science, and Product teams to improve hardware-software integration in industrial environments.
  • Knowledge of electrical equipment and networks, as well as terminology related to this field and their applications: power factor, phase diagram, consumption, reactive power, phases, etc
  • Provide both remote and on-site support to ensure customer satisfaction and reduce downtime.
  • Document technical cases, customer interactions, and solutions through our Helpdesk and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Assist in identifying technical opportunities for upsell, expansion, or system optimization.
  • Share knowledge internally and contribute to the creation of technical documentation related to automation and industrial integration.
Bonus Points
  • Fluent in English.
  • Previous experience in B2B technical support roles or industrial automation projects.
  • Experience with sensor installation and sizing (vibration, temperature, pressure, flow, etc.).
  • Knowledge of SCADA/DCS systems and industrial instrumentation.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Consórcio

A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais.

Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor.

Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade!

Main responsibilities

Estamos em busca de profissionais que queiram fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em Consórcios . Se você já possui experiência na área ou deseja desenvolver sua carreira em um dos segmentos mais tradicionais e estratégicos da Rodobens, esta é a oportunidade ideal para se conectar conosco.

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará em nosso radar para futuras posições alinhadas às suas competências e ao seu potencial de crescimento. Buscamos pessoas que desejam contribuir para soluções financeiras capazes de transformar vidas e apoiar clientes na realização de seus projetos.

Se você quer construir sua trajetória conosco e fazer parte de uma empresa referência no mercado de consórcios, cadastre seu currículo e participe do nosso Banco de Talentos.

Requirements and skills

O que buscamos:

  • Profissionais com experiência ou forte interesse em produtos de consórcio;
  • Perfil consultivo, com forte habilidade em construir e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo e orientado para resultados, com foco no cliente;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e habilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Vivência em vendas, relacionamento com clientes ou rotinas administrativas será um diferencial.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Ariox is an iPaas, or Integration Platform as a Service company. Our iPass solution is Lumino, which efficiently integrates, automates and connects all/any data from various day to day operating systems and applications. For example, an iPaaS can allow a user to connect their ERP, CRM, WMS, or TMS software to each other and share data that may have previously been sorted, moved or shared across systems manually by an employee or other resource. Traditionally, integrating data was a complex process that required equally complex custom solutions and in most cases, was cost prohibitive for the majority of enterprises. iPaaS works to democratize this data sharing and gives control of the integration process to the user themselves. Many implementations of Lumino can be done with lightning speed through the use of pre-built application connectors that make for a plug and play integration experience. Once application connectors are in place, users have the ability to configure those connections, whether that be altering data as it passes between systems, controlling the order of operations within an integration, or simply designating which data sets are part of a given integration.

Ariox is seeking a Full Stack Developer ready to work with new technologies and architecture in this forward-thinking organization that is constantly pushing boundaries. At Ariox, developers must be able to take complete, end-to-end ownership of projects across the entire stack, and be comfortable with both front and back-end programming. Successful candidates will be responsible for developing and designing front-end web architecture, ensuring the responsiveness of applications, coding using pre-established development frameworks and patterns, and utilizing third-party libraries. Ideal candidates will have experience building products across the stack and a firm understanding of web frameworks, APIs, databases, and multiple back-end languages. The successful candidate will be required to complete projects rapidly, and have strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Successful candidates will join a small AGILE team working at the forefront of new technology, solving challenges that impact both the front-end and back-end architecture, and ultimately, delivering unique global user experiences. This role is ideal for someone who is established as a developer and loves to learn new skills. This position will demand continuous improvement of skillsets and technical abilities.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Adhere to and be actively engaged in the established AGILE/ SCRUM process.
  • Responsible for reading and interpreting user stories and creating solution(s) that satisfy the requirements by producing readable and maintainable code using established coding patterns.
  • Provide on-going support for the entire developed product.
  • Create process flowcharts, diagrams, and other related documentation.
  • Engage in the acquisition of current job knowledge by studying new development tools, programming techniques, and computing equipment; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal and professional networks; participating in professional organizations.
  • Participate actively in a hands-on team experience to be productive and make an impact on a daily basis.
  • Collaborate actively and fully with the software development team.

Experience

  • 2 - 3 years of full-stack development experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field
  • Understanding of SOLID principles and clean architecture
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Have strong analytical skills and the ability to think outside the box
  • Be an excellent communicator, a team player, have a positive attitude, and a willingness to get things done
  • Possess an openness and eagerness to learn new technologies
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite of tools

  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;
  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;

  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

Sobre o Grupo Sabin

Referência em saúde, destaque em gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, o Grupo Sabin nasceu na capital federal, fruto da coragem e determinação de duas empreendedoras, Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, em 1984. Hoje conta com cerca de 7000 colaboradores unidos pelo propósito de inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas.

Presente em 14 estados, além do Distrito Federal, a empresa oferece serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental às 354 unidades distribuídas de norte a sul do país.

O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra um portfólio de negócios que contempla análises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo. Além disso, contempla serviços de atenção primária, contribuindo para a gestão de saúde de grupos populacionais por meio de programas e linhas de cuidados coordenados, com a Amparo Saúde, e a plataforma integradora Rita Saúde - solução digital com parcerias como farmácias, médicos e outros profissionais.

Com o objetivo de fomentar o empreendedorismo na saúde, o Grupo lançou em 2020 o SkyHub.Bio, um hub de inovação que atua na promoção e no desenvolvimento de startups, estimulando parcerias, troca de conhecimento e construção de modelos de negócio no setor de saúde.

Como uma empresa nacional sólida, visionária, com valores bem estabelecidos e comprometida com uma agenda ESG, o Grupo Sabin mantém o Instituto Sabin, que desde 2005 trabalha ações de impacto social para melhorar a qualidade de vida e o bem-estar das comunidades onde está presente, fomentando inovação social. O Instituto já impactou positivamente a vida de mais de 1,6 milhões de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais.

Processo Seletivo para seleção de bolsista Gestor(a) Acadêmico no IQSC/USP

Este Processo Seletivo tem por finalidade selecionar um(a) candidato(a) com título de Doutor, para recebimento de uma bolsa para atuar no Programa de Formação em Gestão Acadêmica de Projetos de Pesquisa (FGA), de acordo com as regras estabelecidas pela Resolução CoPI N° 8310, de 29 de agosto de 2022, para atuar no Instituto de Química de São Carlos (IQSC) da Universidade de São Paulo (USP), Campus de São Carlos.

1.1. Atividades a serem desenvolvidas

  • I – Gestão dos entregáveis do projeto, da seleção e supervisão de pessoal, das compras e importações, das entregas de relatórios, da propriedade intelectual, das licenças e autorizações necessárias.
  • II – Prospectar parceiros e financiadores.
  • III – Coordenar iniciativas de divulgação e comunicação.
  • IV – Representar o grupo em conferências e eventos internacionais, bem como em reuniões com potenciais parceiros e financiadores.

1.2. Grupos de pesquisa atendidos

  • Grupo de Processos Eletroquímicos e Ambientais (GPEA), coordenado Prof. Marcos Lanza, localizado no Edifício de Química Ambiental do IQSC, Área II do Campus de São Carlos.
  • Grupo de Cromatografia (CROMA), coordenado Prof. Fernando Lanças, localizado no Edifício de Q9 do IQSC, Área I do Campus de São Carlos.

2. Requisitos do(a) candidato(a)

  • O(A) candidato(a) ao Programa deve possuir título de Doutor de qualquer instituição, nacional ou estrangeira.
  • O(A) candidato(a) deve possuir experiência na área de conhecimento do projeto em que realizará seu treinamento/participará.
  • Docentes, servidores(as) técnicos e administrativos, alunos(as), pós-doutorandos(as) e pesquisadores(as) colaboradores(as) da USP não podem participar do Programa, mesmo em caso de afastamento.
  • O(A) participante não poderá possuir vínculo empregatício, mesmo em caso de afastamento.
  • A dedicação ao Programa será de 40 (quarenta) horas semanais em regime de dedicação exclusiva.
  • Não será permitida a acumulação da bolsa do Programa de Formação em Gestão Acadêmica de Projetos de Pesquisa com bolsas pagas por agências de fomento, empresas e demais financiadores, e outras bolsas da Universidade de São Paulo.

3. Valor da bolsa

3.1. R$ 8.479,20 (oito mil quatrocentos e nove reais e vinte centavos) mensais brutos (antes da incidência de imposto de renda) pelo período de 12 meses.

3.2. As bolsas poderão ser prorrogadas por até 12 meses, a critério da Pró-Reitoria de Pesquisa e Inovação, e de acordo com a disponibilidade de recursos.

4. Prazos previstos para inscrições, documentos e seleção do bolsista

4.1. O(A) candidato(a) interessado na bolsa deverá efetuar sua inscrição enviando toda a documentação exigida para os seguintes e-mails e até as 18h do dia .

4.2. Os documentos requeridos para a inscrição são a comprovação do título de doutor; o curriculum vitae; e os documentos pessoais.

Fonte: Marcos Lanza (IQSC/USP)
